note: Add NFLX 70C to the options watchlist — NOTE: schema has no list_id (options land in a dedicated option watchlist).

response.guide: Each option_id is added as a single-leg position with the supplied position_type (defaults to "long"). "no options watchlist found" in the error means the user has not enabled options trading — surface that to the user rather than retrying. Re-adding a contract that is already on the list is a no-op.
